name: 戈兰·绞柄
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1091
who: Goran Winchhand, a tiefling of the black empire's contract-folk who has kept the winch and the pumps of a seeping air chamber on the thirtieth floor of the great dungeon for thirty years, about sixty-five and looking his age: short, about 165 cm, but his two arms are thick as a young smith's, far stronger than his years. Short iron-blue hair cropped close and streaked with grey. Two short horns curving back from the temples, the root of each wound with a strip of oily rag he wipes the winch with. Pale brown eyes with a gold glint. Hard calluses across both palms, worn by chain. A gruff, patient, steady-handed air; he talks to the chain like an old dog.
face: FACE, as in the references: a weathered man's face of about sixty-five, broad and square-jawed: deep lines at the eye corners and across the brow, pale brown eyes with a gold glint under thick grey-blue brows, a short grizzled stubble, a closed, patient mouth. Fair skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 165 cm, short and stocky: a deep chest and very thick, strong arms and wrists.
palette: iron blue and grey, chain-oil black, pale gold-brown, canvas olive, a little brass
casual: His keeper's work clothes: a heavy olive canvas work coat with obsidian-steel buttons and the sleeves rolled to the elbow, a small dark cloth patch with his contract mark sewn on the left breast (on the viewer's right when he faces us), a coarse grey shirt, dark trousers tucked into heavy boots with iron toe caps; a broad belt hung with a long wrench, an oil can and a small pouch of pump crystals that glow faint blue. A coil of heavy winch chain hangs over one shoulder, one big hand on it, a gruff, steady look.
private: In his bunk room off the air chamber after the shift: a faded grey wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up, a dark brown knitted waistcoat, dark trousers and soft felt slippers, the rags still wound round his horn roots. In both hands he holds a small dented tin cup, carefully upright and full to the brim, as if nothing in the world should spill it. A quiet, almost tender look.
battle: Keeping the air chamber, in the little issue gear a contract keeper gets: the olive canvas work coat buttoned to the throat under an old black-empire leather apron, re-stitched, with a thin dark-red rune line along its hem that glows faintly against water and cold; brass goggles pushed up on the forehead between the horns; brass-buckled insulated gloves; a small crystal cell at the belt glowing pale blue for the pumps. Both hands grip a heavy winch chain, its links worn bright.
battle_pose: 3) the working outfit: braced and immovable, the feet planted wide and the knees a little bent, a firm, unsmiling expression, both gloved hands hauling on a heavy winch chain held across his body; he carries no weapon.
formal: The contract-folk's best on a feast day of the contract street: a clean black wool coat buttoned to the collar with dark obsidian buttons, its collar lined in dark red, the contract patch freshly stitched, a white shirt, the horn roots wound with clean new cloth instead of rag, polished boots. He stands very straight with the big hands folded in front, a solemn, stubborn look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale gold-brown eyes looking at the viewer from under grey-blue brows, one thick hand gripping a chain link beside his face. Cold blue light from glowing pump crystals on one side, a wet gleam on his horns. Foreground blur: drifting water droplets, a tilted tin cup on a wooden stake and swinging chain links. He wears the olive canvas work coat.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜契约民，在第三十层守气室三十年，页上没写位阶，估作灵格；家里穷，又不出手，只在工装外头加一件黑耀旧皮围裙（一线护身符文）、护目镜、黄铜扣的绝缘手套和泵用的小晶匣，是这一段西边匠人的样子。

name: 贝内特·七钟
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1085
who: Bennet Seventh-Bell, a demon-kin of the white-bone folk, named under the seventh bell tower of the city of bone bells, the reckoning officer of the black empire's deep-well office and a hero, of no readable age, looking about forty: about 190 cm, thin and tall, his back straight as a surveyor's rod. Skin white as porcelain. Lead-white hair cut short and very even. Pale violet eyes. On his brow a small patch of bare white bone carved with a row of seven short notches, his tower's mark. On his left hand (on the viewer's right when he faces us) three of the fingers are bare white bone, each fitted with a thin brass counting ring that he slides notch by notch without a sound. A precise, cold, unhurried air; he believes in the number.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, severe man's face of about forty, long and narrow: pale violet eyes under straight pale brows, a thin straight nose, a thin closed mouth; on the brow a small patch of bare white bone with seven short carved notches in a row. Porcelain-white skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft cool grey.
build: 190 cm, tall and thin, with a rigidly straight back and long hands.
palette: porcelain white and lead white, black, dark red, pale violet, brass
casual: His office clothes: a long black fitted coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat and narrow dark-red piping, a black waistcoat, a white shirt, black trousers and polished boots; the deep-well office's bronze seal on a short chain at the belt; the three brass counting rings on the bare finger bones of his left hand. He stands very straight with a folded contract held in his right hand, a cold, exact look.
private: In his quarters at the deep-well office: a plain white shirt buttoned to the collar, a dark grey knitted waistcoat, black trousers and soft shoes. He holds a thin ledger open on his right forearm and counts on the brass rings of his left hand. A still, absorbed look.
battle: Down at the sealed air chamber, in the black empire's officer harness: the long black coat with the stand collar under a slim breastplate and pauldrons of black obsidian steel edged in dark red, engraved with fine straight rune lines like tally marks that glow a dull red; a dark-red sash; a black gauntlet on the right hand; the brass counting rings on the bare bones of his left hand glowing faint gold. He holds upright like a staff a long black iron surveyor's rod as tall as he is, banded with brass at measured intervals. A cold, level look.
formal: At the signing in the guild's commission hall: a long black dress coat with a stand collar, dark-red lining and a single row of small obsidian buttons, the deep-well office's black-and-red sash, a white glove on the right hand, the bare finger bones of the left hand with their brass rings, the bronze office seal on its chain. He stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a severe, formal look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the pale violet eyes looking at the viewer without blinking, the bare bones of his left hand raised beside his face, a brass counting ring pushed along a finger bone. Cold blue-grey light of a flooded chamber from one side. Foreground blur: hanging winch chain links, drifting water droplets and the edge of a black stone tablet. He wears the long black coat with the stand collar.
gear: 英雄｜中｜照常｜4档｜底座写英雄，英雄往上不看家境；黑耀深井署的军官，照这一段西边的黑红军大衣配黑曜钢甲片；页上没写兵器，起一根包铜箍的黑铁量杆（★，照他背挺得像一根量杆）。

name: 哈尔文·钉锤
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1835
who: Halvin Nailhammer, a dwarf, deputy of the adventurers' guild hall, who from about the year 983 really runs its daily business, in a dwarf's prime at about two hundred and twenty: about 138 cm, short, broad and square, standing as if planted behind a counter. Ash-blond hair combed straight back; an ash-blond beard in two thick braids, each clasped at the end with a square iron ring shaped like a nail head. Steel-blue eyes under heavy brows that look at the form before the face. Ink stains on the first two fingers of the right hand. No glasses. A strict, brisk, unsmiling air with newcomers, but gentle with anyone who came back alive.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dwarf's face in the prime of life, broad and square, NOT old and NOT a child's: steel-blue eyes under heavy ash-blond brows, a broad straight nose, a firm mouth half hidden by the moustache, a few lines at the eye corners; no glasses. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 138 cm, short, broad and square, with thick forearms.
palette: ash blond and steel blue, deep slate, ink black, polished brass
casual: His guild-hall clothes: a white shirt with black sleeve protectors to the elbow, a fitted deep slate-blue wool waistcoat with brass buttons, a narrow belt with a heavy brass guild stamp in a leather holster, dark trousers and polished boots; the guild's bronze rank emblem on a cord. He holds a wooden clipboard of blank forms against his chest with one hand and taps it with an inky finger, a stern, impatient look.
private: Off duty at the old tavern by the shaft mouth: the waistcoat unbuttoned over the white shirt, the sleeve protectors off and the sleeves rolled up, the beard braids loosened, soft boots. He holds a small pewter mug of beer in one hand, a rare, gruff, kind half-smile.
battle: Called down to a deep camp, in a guild deputy's war harness: a fitted deep slate-blue coat with a stand collar buttoned to the throat under a slim dwarven breastplate and gorget of dark mountain-copper engraved with fine rune lines that glow a steady amber, matching pauldrons and vambraces, a brass guild seal set at the breastbone glowing soft gold, heavy boots with steel toe caps. He grips in both hands a short-hafted war hammer with a broad striking face on one side and a split claw on the other, a nail-head rune on its face glowing amber. A grim, unhurried look.
formal: At the guild's opening of the descending season: a long fitted deep slate-blue coat with a stand collar, brass piping and a single row of small brass buttons, a dark green sash across the chest with the deputy's brass key badge, white gloves, the beard braids freshly clasped. He holds the guild register closed in both hands in front of him, standing very straight, a stern, dignified look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the steel-blue eyes looking up at the viewer over a raised form as if asking whether it is filled in, the inky fingers holding the paper. Warm lamplight of the guild hall from one side. Foreground blur: the edge of a wooden counter, a brass stamp coming down and drifting slips of paper. He wears the slate-blue waistcoat with the black sleeve protectors.
gear: 极境（估，底卡今天 LVL 118）｜中｜照常｜3档｜底卡写他今天极境，这一段估作极境；公会次席，家底中等，到了极境家境差不了多少；穿成套的东边收身外套配矮人山铜薄胸甲，招牌是一面锤头一面羊角爪的短柄战锤，照他的姓起（★）。

name: 瑟兰
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1836
who: Seran, a half-elf, chief appraiser of the guild's echo appraisal office, who has stood behind its counter since the year 961, about sixty-five but looking about thirty-two: about 180 cm, tall and narrow-shouldered, leaning a little as if bored. Pale platinum hair, long and straight, tied low at the nape with a black ribbon. Heavy-lidded violet eyes that look tired of everything and miss nothing. Slightly pointed ears, a little longer than a human's. A thin white scar across the back of his right hand (on the viewer's left when he faces us), where a relic once bit him. A dry, lazy, sharp air; there is no fake he cannot spot, only truths he cannot be bothered to say.
build: 180 cm, tall and slim, with narrow shoulders and long fingers.
palette: pale platinum and violet, grey-white, black, brass
casual: His appraiser's clothes: the office's long grey-white smock cut like a coat, closing down the front with small buttons, over a black waistcoat and a white shirt with a narrow black ribbon tie; thin white cotton gloves; dark trousers and soft shoes; a brass-framed jeweller's loupe on a fine chain clipped to the waistcoat. He holds up a small cracked brass gear between gloved finger and thumb, looking at it sideways, a bored, knowing look.
private: In his rooms above the appraisal office: a loose dark violet linen shirt open at the throat, black trousers and soft slippers, the hair untied. He holds a cup of tea in one hand and a thin book in the other, reading with half-closed eyes. A lazy, content look.
battle: When a relic wakes on the counter, in the appraisal office's ward gear: the long grey-white smock over a slim fitted breastplate of pale rune-inscribed steel whose lines glow soft violet, a high gorget, a long-cuffed left gauntlet set with three small lens crystals that read echoes and throw a thin violet light; a white glove on the right hand. He holds a slim straight sword with a plain guard in his right hand, NOT a curved sword, and raises the gauntleted left hand, a fine lattice of violet light spreading from its lenses. A cool, unimpressed look.
formal: At the council's hearing on a disputed relic: a long black fitted coat with a stand collar and silver piping over a grey waistcoat, white gloves, the office's small silver badge of an open eye within a ring at the collar, the hair neatly tied with the black ribbon. He stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a composed, faintly bored look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, one violet eye seen through the brass loupe held up close, the other heavy-lidded, a faint dry smile. Cold white lamplight from one side catching the lens. Foreground blur: a small cracked relic, drifting dust and a scatter of tiny brass gears. He wears the grey-white appraiser's smock.
gear: 极境（估，底卡今天 LVL 96）｜中｜照常｜3档｜底卡写他今天极境；鉴定台后头站了三十几年，到了极境家境差不了多少；穿鉴定所护身的整套，招牌是嵌三片读残响镜片的左手长手甲，残响在台上醒了才动手（手甲和细剑★）。

name: 科达
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1837
who: Korda, a human, the patrolman of the lower city who keeps the peace in and around the Grey Lane, about forty but looking thirty-two or thirty-three: about 183 cm, rangy and loose-limbed, broad in the shoulders. Black hair with a dark blue sheen, a little long, tied back in a short tail, a few strands loose over the brow. Olive-green eyes. An old scar cuts through his left eyebrow (on the viewer's right when he faces us), so that he keeps that eye a little narrowed, as if always half closing it on purpose. A short stubble on the jaw. A lazy, unhurried, watchful air; he sees everything in the lane and decides what he did not see.
build: 183 cm, rangy and broad-shouldered, with long arms.
palette: dark slate blue, olive green, brass, lantern amber, black
casual: His patrol clothes: the lower city watch's long dark slate-blue coat, worn open, with brass buttons and a small brass watch badge pinned at the chest, over a grey waistcoat and an open-collared shirt, dark trousers tucked into worn boots; at his belt a small shuttered lantern and a hardwood truncheon bound with three iron bands. One thumb hooked in the belt, a lazy, knowing half-smile.
private: Off duty in his room over a lower-city bakery: a loose undyed shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark knitted vest, braces, dark trousers and soft boots, the hair untied. He holds a paper bag of warm bread rolls in one hand, as if about to leave it somewhere for someone. A wry, gentle look.
battle: On a night raid in the lower city, in a watch captain's war kit: the slate-blue watch coat buttoned to a stand collar under a slim rune-inscribed steel breastplate whose engraved lines glow soft amber, city-watch steel pauldrons and vambraces, brass goggles pushed up on the forehead, a brass-buckled insulated glove on the left hand, the shuttered lantern at the belt burning with a bright crystal flame. He grips the iron-banded hardwood truncheon in his right hand, its bands glowing faint amber with a stunning rune; a short straight sword stays sheathed at his left hip. A calm, narrow-eyed look.
formal: At the city's ceasefire-day parade: the lower city watch's dress coat in dark slate blue with a stand collar, brass piping and two rows of brass buttons, a white cross-belt, white gloves, the brass watch badge polished, the hair tied neatly. He stands very straight with the hands behind his back, a look of polite, patient boredom.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the olive-green eyes looking at the viewer with the scarred left eye narrowed, a knowing half-smile, as if deciding not to have seen something. Warm amber lantern light from below on one side against the blue dusk of a narrow lane. Foreground blur: raindrops, a fluttering scrap of a child's scarf and the glow of a lantern. He wears the long slate-blue watch coat.
gear: 极境（估，底卡今天 LVL 88）｜贫｜照常｜3档｜底卡写他今天极境；下城巡卫出身，到了极境家境只差一截，穿城防发的整套加刻铭文的薄胸甲；招牌是三道铁箍的硬木短棍，拿棍不拔剑是他的脾气（★）。

name: 葛蕾塔
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1859
who: Greta, a human widow of the lower city of the dungeon city, who on the day her husband did not come up from the dungeon took home a dying stranger's little daughter and her wooden staff, about fifty: about 165 cm, solid and straight-backed, quick on her feet. Auburn hair streaked with grey, pinned up in a bun under a faded blue kerchief. Dark honey-gold eyes and a sharp mouth that scolds first. Laugh lines at the eyes. A plain gold wedding ring worn on a cord at her neck. A sharp-tongued, soft-hearted air; when the girl comes home late, she waits at the door.
face: FACE, as in the references: a woman's face of about fifty, strong and warm: lines at the eye corners and beside the mouth, dark honey-gold eyes with a stern, worried look, straight auburn brows touched with grey, a firm mouth. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft warm tone.
build: 165 cm, solid and straight-backed: sturdy shoulders, a full bust, a thick waist and broad hips.
palette: auburn and grey, faded blue, dark honey gold, cream, a little brown
casual: Her house clothes: a long dark blue-grey wool dress with long sleeves, a cream apron with deep pockets, a brown knitted shawl crossed over the chest and tied at the back, sturdy shoes; the faded blue kerchief over her bun; the gold ring on its cord at her neck. She stands with one hand on her hip and the other holding a wooden spoon, a stern, scolding look that is half a smile.
private: At home after supper: a loose long-sleeved cream blouse, a long brown wool skirt, a thick grey knitted cardigan, the hair let down in a loose grey-streaked braid, soft slippers. She holds a girl's small pink-trimmed dress she is mending, a needle in her other hand. A tired, fond look.
battle: On the night the girl did not come home, going out after her: her late husband's old adventurer's cloak, deep green and patched, thrown over the blue-grey dress and pinned at the throat; a worn ward charm on a cord that still glows faintly; his old bronze guild emblem hung beside it, its light long gone dark; sturdy boots. She holds up a small shuttered lantern with a white crystal flame and carries no weapon.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and ready, the feet planted, a stern, worried expression, one hand raising a small shuttered lantern, the other clenched at her side; she carries no weapon.
formal: On the Ceasefire Day reading of names, when her husband's name is read: a long black wool dress with long sleeves and a high plain collar closed with small black buttons, a black lace shawl, black gloves, the gold ring on its cord outside the dress, a small sprig of white flowers pinned at the collar. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a firm, dry-eyed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the honey-gold eyes looking out at the viewer from a half-open doorway, stern and worried, softening at the edges, one hand on the door frame. Warm lamplight from inside the house on one side, cool blue night on the other. Foreground blur: a few loose flower petals, the top of a wooden staff wrapped in faded pink cloth and a wisp of steam. She wears the faded blue kerchief and the brown shawl.
gear: 启源（估）｜贫｜不打仗｜1档｜下城的寡妇，不出手；战斗那一格画夜里出门找孩子，披亡夫的旧冒险者斗篷，挂一枚还微微亮的护身符，提一盏晶匣灯，不拿兵器（★）。

name: 桑托·晴林
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1861
who: Santo Sunwood, a human adventurer of the guild at the wind rank, from a little village by a vine-hung stream in the southern forests, about twenty: about 182 cm, long-limbed and strong in the shoulders, always moving. Messy, spiky sun-bleached honey-orange hair. Bright leaf-green eyes. A wide, loud grin with a small chip off one front tooth. A strip of green cloth woven with a vine pattern, from his home village, tied round his left upper arm (on the viewer's right when he faces us). He carries an absurdly huge plain greatsword, nearly as tall as he is, which he calls Mountain-Splitter. A cheerful, boastful, warm-hearted air; he tells everyone he is going to be a hero.
palette: sun orange and leaf green, worn leather brown, cream, iron grey
casual: His adventurer's clothes: a cream shirt with the sleeves rolled up, an old boiled-leather jerkin with a few iron plates nailed on the shoulders, a faded green short cape, dark trousers and worn boots, a belt with a pouch and a coil of rope; the guild's bronze wind-rank emblem, a feather and an arrow, on a cord at the chest; the vine-patterned green cloth on his left upper arm. On his back, in a leather harness, the absurdly huge plain iron greatsword, its broad blade nearly as tall as he is. One fist thumped on his chest, a huge, proud grin.
private: Fixing things for a friend in the lower city: a loose undyed linen shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a brown waistcoat hanging open, dark trousers and sturdy boots, no sword. He holds a hammer in one hand and a small hand-carved wooden cart wheel under the other arm. A happy, sweaty grin.
battle: On the escort road north, in a cheap adventurer's few salvaged pieces: the boiled-leather jerkin with iron-plated shoulders, one old enchanted pauldron strapped on the right shoulder whose rune line glows faint blue-white, a scuffed rune-etched vambrace on the left forearm, the green cape scorched at the hem, the vine-patterned cloth on his left arm. He holds the absurdly huge plain iron greatsword in both hands, its broad blade low and forward, a single dull rune line along the fuller giving off a faint warm glow. A fierce, determined grin.
formal: The day he made the wind rank: his only good coat, a dark green wool jacket a little too tight across the shoulders, buttoned up over a clean white shirt, the bronze wind-rank emblem polished on its cord, the hair still sticking up, the greatsword on his back. He stands very straight, chest out, a proud, slightly nervous grin.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the leaf-green eyes laughing at the viewer with a huge chipped-tooth grin, one thumb pointing back at the hilt of the huge greatsword over his shoulder. Bright warm noon light pouring down from above on one side, as through a broken roof. Foreground blur: falling flower petals, splintered roof shingles and a few drifting leaves. He wears the boiled-leather jerkin with the green cape.
gear: 灵格（估）｜贫｜照常｜1档｜旅印到风路，页上没写位阶，估作灵格；南边小村子出身，家里穷，灵格减一档，旧皮甲外头只罩一只捡来的附魔肩甲和一只护臂；劈山是一把大得不像话的寻常铁剑，底卡说不是名器，只给一线暗暗的符文。

name: 莫特·盐秤
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1889
who: Mott Saltscale, a human trader who has kept the supply post at the bone-bridge outpost on the forty-fifth floor of the great dungeon for over ten years and will not leave, a little over fifty: about 172 cm, lean and wiry, a little stooped from carrying. Very short grey-blue hair shaved close to the scalp. Sharp pale green eyes that can tell when a balance beam is a hair out of true. A short stub of charcoal pencil clipped behind his right ear for the accounts (on the viewer's left when he faces us). A weathered, dry, stubborn air; he haggles over every coin and never raises a price on a bad day.
face: FACE, as in the references: a lean, weathered man's face of a little over fifty: lines at the eye corners and across the brow, narrow sharp pale green eyes, a long straight nose, thin firm lips, a grey stubble. Clean skin with very little shading; skin shadows a soft cool tone.
build: 172 cm, lean and wiry, a little stooped.
palette: grey-blue and salt white, pale green, oilcloth olive-brown, polished brass
casual: His trader's clothes: a heavy oilcloth short coat with pockets sewn on in layers over a thick grey wool shirt, a long canvas apron, dark trousers tucked into heavy boots; at his waist hangs a long brass steelyard for weighing salt, its weight polished bright; a small salt sack over one shoulder; the charcoal pencil behind his right ear. He holds a battered account book open in one hand, a shrewd, dry look.
private: In his little lean-to at the outpost: a loose grey-blue wool shirt with the sleeves rolled up, a dark knitted vest, soft boots, the oilcloth coat off. He holds a small cloth bag of salt in his palm, weighing it by hand. A quiet, satisfied look.
battle: Holding the bone bridge, in the old war gear a deep-floor trader keeps: the oilcloth coat buttoned under a mended boiled-leather jerkin with a few iron plates on the shoulders, one plate etched with a blue-white ward rune that glows faintly; brass goggles hung round the neck; a small crystal lamp at the belt glowing pale. The brass steelyard beam hangs at his waist; its polished brass weight, unhooked, is gripped in his right fist.
battle_pose: 3) the battle outfit: braced and steady, the feet planted, a firm, unsmiling expression, the polished brass weight of his salt scale gripped in one fist and raised a little as if to knock out a signal; he carries no weapon.
formal: Up at the guild hall to settle his accounts: a clean dark brown wool coat with plain horn buttons over a white shirt and a grey waistcoat, polished boots, the brass steelyard hung neatly at his waist, the charcoal pencil still behind his ear. He holds his account book closed in both hands, standing straight, a stiff, dignified look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the sharp pale green eyes looking sideways past the viewer as if reading a light on a far wall, his back half turned. A pale dawn-white glow thrown on one side of his face, as if reflected off a cliff. Foreground blur: the polished brass weight of a steelyard, pale bone railings and drifting salt grains. He wears the oilcloth short coat.
gear: 灵格（估）｜中｜不打仗｜2档｜在第四十五层的骨桥前哨守货十几年，页上没写位阶，估作灵格；卖货的家底中等；不出手，旧皮甲肩上钉铁片、一片刻护身符文，护目镜挂在脖子上，手里只有那一枚秤砣。

name: 凹盾
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1911
who: Dentshield, a dragonborn of a scattered line, a shield-bearer of the guild at the star-chart rank and a hero, known only by the nickname the soldiers on the wall gave him, looking about thirty-five: about 204 cm, huge and heavy-set, broad as a door. Copper-red scales cover his neck, run along the jaw and up to the temples, and spread over both shoulders and down both arms to the backs of the hands; the face itself is a man's, with a few fine scales on the cheekbones. Coarse short charcoal-black hair with a copper sheen, swept back. Pale jade-green eyes with narrow vertical slit pupils. One scale on the bridge of the nose is broken off and never grew back. A terse, gruff air: he curses once, then steps in front.
face: FACE, as in the references: a dragonborn man's face of about thirty-five, broad, heavy-browed and rough: pale jade-green eyes with narrow vertical slit pupils, a few small copper-red scales on the cheekbones and along the jaw, one scale broken off on the bridge of the nose, a wide set mouth. Clean skin with very little shading, skin shadows a soft warm copper tone.
build: 204 cm, huge and heavy-set: a massive chest, very broad shoulders and thick arms.
palette: copper red and charcoal, jade green, dented steel grey, dark leather, a little amber
casual: His everyday gear: a heavy dark-red leather long vest over a coarse charcoal shirt with a vent slit down the back for the scales, a broad belt, dark trousers tucked into heavy boots; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem, an astrolabe with linked stars, on a cord at the chest. On his back, on a thick strap, a huge steel tower shield whose whole face is covered with hundreds of dents, none ever hammered flat. Arms folded, a gruff scowl.
private: Off duty at a tavern by the shaft mouth: a loose undyed wool shirt with the sleeves pushed up over the scaled forearms, a dark leather waistcoat, dark trousers and soft boots, no shield. He turns a small smith's hammer over in one hand and never uses it, a dry, amused look.
battle: Holding the line, in a hero's war harness made for him: full plate of dark steel enamelled along the edges in copper red to match his scales, the plates cut with vents so the scales can breathe, deep rune lines on the breastplate and great pauldrons glowing a steady amber, a short dark cape, heavy gauntlets and sabatons. On his left arm the huge steel tower shield, its face covered with hundreds of unbeaten dents, each dent rimmed with a thread of amber ward light, the newest seven still bright. In his right hand a short, heavy, straight broad-bladed sword, NOT a curved sword. A set, scowling look.
formal: Called before the guild's council to report: a long dark-red wool coat with a stand collar and copper buttons, cut loose at the back for the scales, a broad black belt, the bronze star-chart emblem polished at the chest, polished boots; the dented tower shield still on his back, because he will not leave it. He stands very straight, arms at his sides, a gruff, impatient look.
art: A portrait from slightly below with the camera tilted, the face large, the jade-green slit-pupilled eyes glaring at the viewer over the battered rim of the tower shield, a gruff half-scowl. Hot amber light from one side striking sparks off the dents in the shield. Foreground blur: the edge of the dented shield, flying sparks and drifting brass gear teeth. He wears the dark-red leather long vest.
gear: 英雄（LVL 186 上下）｜中｜照常｜4档｜英雄往上不看家境，量身打的重甲；渊垒，招牌是那面满是坑的塔盾，坑一个也不敲平是他的脾气，坑边亮一线护身的光（★），976年球殿门口新添的七个还亮着。

name: 听针
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1912
who: Needle-Ear, an elf who lives outside the forests, a hunter of the guild at the star-chart rank and a hero, known only by the nickname the wall soldiers gave her, looking about twenty-five: about 170 cm, slender and light, moving without a sound. Long, straight pale rose-gold hair falling to the waist, gathered loosely at the back with a leather thong. Deep cornflower-blue eyes, often closed when she listens. Long pointed ears, keen enough to hear a needle drop; a tiny silver pin through the rim of the left ear (on the viewer's right when she faces us). A cool, quiet, attentive air; she will not pick up anything that still turns.
build: 170 cm, slender and light: a small bust, a narrow waist and slim hips, long legs.
palette: pale rose gold and cornflower blue, deep forest green, pale birch, a little silver
casual: Her hunter's clothes: a fitted deep forest-green leather jacket over a cream shirt, a short grey-green hooded cape with the hood down, slim dark trousers and soft boots, a quiver of pale-fletched arrows at the hip; the guild's bronze star-chart rank emblem on a cord at the chest. She holds a long recurved bow of pale birch with silver-capped tips loosely at her side, a still, listening look.
private: In her rented room in the dungeon city: a loose long-sleeved cream knitted sweater, slim grey trousers, bare feet, the hair let down. She holds a cup of warm tea in both hands, eyes closed, listening. A calm, private look.
battle: Listening on the deep floors, in a hero hunter's harness made for her: a fitted jacket of dark green dragonhide over a slim rune-stitched leather cuirass whose seams glow faint silver-green, a high collar, a leather bracer on the bow arm inlaid with a thin line of ether crystal, a short grey-green cape whose hem is woven with a silver ward thread, the quiver of crystal-headed arrows glowing pale at the hip. She holds the long pale-birch recurved bow with an arrow nocked and the string half drawn, a faint silver light along the arrow, her eyes closed, listening.
formal: At the guild's opening of the descending season: a long fitted forest-green coat with a stand collar and silver piping, a pale grey sash, slim dark trousers and polished boots, the star-chart emblem polished at the chest, the hair braided neatly over one shoulder, the silver pin in her ear. She stands very straight with the hands folded in front, a cool, composed look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the eyes closed, the head tilted so one long pointed ear with its tiny silver pin turns toward the viewer, listening. Cold pale mist-light from one side. Foreground blur: a tiny brass gear still turning in the air, drifting fog and a single falling needle catching the light. She wears the forest-green leather jacket.
gear: 英雄（LVL 178 上下）｜中｜照常｜4档｜英雄不看家境，量身做的猎手战装；行猎靠耳朵，甲做轻做静，不带会响的东西，招牌是那张桦木反曲长弓（★）。

name: 疤手
src: 迷宫纪前传/迷宫纪前传时段_六_垂暮的年月.md:1913
who: Scarhand, a human healer of the White Candle and a hero of the guild at the key-and-door rank, known only by the nickname the wall soldiers gave her, forty in the year 976 but looking about twenty-seven: about 167 cm, slim and upright. Pale apricot hair cut to the shoulders, the front half tied back. Clear sky-blue eyes. A round burn scar in the middle of each palm, from the night a lamp shade burst in her hands on the first wall when she was fourteen; she never hides them. A gentle, steady, unflinching air.
build: 167 cm, slim and upright: a medium bust, a narrow waist and gently rounded hips.
palette: candle white and pale apricot, sky blue, soft gold, a little pale grey
casual: Her healer's clothes: the White Candle's long white robe that closes down the front with small buttons, fitted sleeves turned back once at the cuff, a narrow pale grey belt hung with a pouch of bandage linen and a small vial case, soft white boots; the guild's bronze key-and-door-ring rank emblem on a cord at the chest. Her hands are bare, the palms turned a little outward so the burn scars show. A calm, kind look.
private: At home in a small room behind the infirmary: a soft pale blue long-sleeved linen dress, a cream knitted shawl, soft slippers, the hair loose. She holds a small unlit glass lamp in both scarred hands, turning it. A thoughtful, gentle look.
battle: Going down with a party, in a hero healer's battle robe made for her: the long white robe cut shorter for walking, over a slim breastplate of pale steel engraved with fine flame-shaped runes that glow soft gold; white leather vambraces stitched with a gold ward thread; a white short cape lined in pale gold; a vial case at the belt. In her left hand a tall slim staff topped by a shielded lamp of clear crystal burning with a steady white-gold flame; her bare right palm is held out, a ring of soft white light gathering over the scar.
formal: At the White Candle's rite of lamps: a long white robe to the floor with a high plain collar and gold piping, a pale gold stole embroidered with small flames, a white veil pinned back from the face, the bronze rank emblem on its cord. She holds a small lit glass lamp in both bare scarred hands in front of her, standing very straight, a serene look.
art: A portrait with the camera tilted, the face large, the sky-blue eyes looking steadily at the viewer, one bare palm raised beside her face showing the burn scar, a soft white-gold glow rising from it. Warm candle light from below on one side. Foreground blur: a dark iron seal falling away, drifting sparks and the glass rim of a lamp. She wears the White Candle's white robe.
gear: 英雄（LVL 159 上下）｜中｜法袍｜4档｜英雄不看家境；白烛悲悯，治人的，不爱穿重甲，量身做的是战用的短白袍配一副薄胸甲和一根灯杖（灯杖★，照她十四岁在墙上举灯）。
